en.text: Today, it is clear weather for the vicinity of the airport; temperature is 20 degrees Celcius.

original: 「なんで傘持ってこなかったの？」「だって朝あんなに晴れてたじゃん」

en.text: "Why didn't you bring an umbrella?" "It was such good weather this morning!"

original: 晴れた日には遠くに富士山が見えます。

en.text: On a clear day, we can see Mt. Fuji in the distance.

original: 突然に、晴れてきたようだ。

en.text: Suddenly, it started to look almost nice and warm.

original: 晴れの日には、ここから富士山が見えます。

en.text: On a clear day, we can see Mt. Fuji from here.
On a clear day, you can see Mt. Fuji from here.

original: 自分の気持ちを話すだけでも、気分は晴れてくるよ。

en.text: Just talking about your feelings can make you feel better.

original: 今日はよく晴れてるよ。

en.text: It is sunny today.
It's sunny today.

original: もうすぐ晴れてきそうだよ。

en.text: It's going to clear up soon.
It'll clear up soon.

original: 晴れてたから、ハイキングに行ったのよ。

en.text: Since it was sunny, we went on a hike.

original: 晴れそうだよ。

en.text: It looks like it'll be clearing up.

original: 明日はほぼ確実に晴れだよ。

en.text: It ought to be fine tomorrow.

original: いきなりザアッと雨が激しく降ったかと思ったら、今はカラッと晴れている。

en.text: First it starts bucketing down, then all of a sudden the weather clears up.

original: 明日晴れたらピクニックに行くつもりなんです。

en.text: We'll go on a picnic if it's fine tomorrow.

original: 気分が晴れないから、美味しいものでも食べにいこっと。

en.text: I'm feeling down, so I'll go out to eat something tasty.

original: 空の感じでは、午後には晴れそうですよ。

en.text: Judging from the look of the sky, it will clear up in the afternoon.

original: ちょっと前まで晴れてたのに。

en.text: It was sunny a just minute ago.

original: 暖かくて晴れた日はピクニックにもってこいだよ。

en.text: A warm, sunny day is ideal for a picnic.

original: ちょっとずつ、空が晴れてきた。

en.text: Little by little, the sky is clearing up.

original: 日曜日は晴れてほしいですね。

en.text: I hope the weather will clear up on Sunday.

original: 朝は雨でしたが、今は晴れています。

en.text: It was raining this morning, but now it's sunny.

original: 外は晴れてる？

en.text: Is it sunny outside?

original: 明日は晴れよ。

en.text: It will be sunny tomorrow.
It'll be sunny tomorrow.

original: 晴れの日は、ビーチはごった返す。

en.text: On sunny days, the beach is very crowded.
On sunny days, the beach is crowded.

original: 雨だろうが晴れだろうが、行くよ。

en.text: I'll go, rain or shine.
